title: DecisionRecorded
description: A brief was answered, from whichever channel answered first, or its default applied at the deadline. Topic hotl.brief; subject and key: the brief id. Producer: Review service. Main consumers: Orchestrator (signal), knowledge graph.

option.description: Chosen option id, for example A. Absent for a free-text answer.

text.description: Free-text answer or note from the reviewer.

defaulted.description: True when no one answered and the brief's default option applied at the deadline.

changesCriteria.description: True when the answer changes the acceptance criteria, so a new intent version needs the PO's signature.
